description:
Kesoram Industries Limited is a flagship company of B. K. Birla group. The Co is engaged in the manufacturing of Cement and Rayon, TP & Chemicals. [1]

Key Points:
Business Segments Cement (94% in FY24 vs 98% in FY22) - It manufactures cement under the brand “Birla Shakti Cement”. It sells premium cement under the brand “Birla Shakti ConQUerete”.
